subject: Re: Discovery recap & private deployment options
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — private/dedicated option (post-call recap)

Tom / Ava — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of needs:
- PHI-sensitive workloads, must meet enterprise controls (SOC 2 type II, audit logs).
- Latency target: P95 < 100ms for primary inference path.
- Expected throughput: ~3–5 concurrent streams during peak, occasional bursts.
- Preference: on-prem or VPC/private control plane; procurement timeline likely Q3.

What we propose:
1) Short architecture workshop (30–45m) to map network & integration constraints (KMS, VPC peering, Egress controls).
2) Pilot on Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) or Redwood Private (VPC/on‑prem) depending on your security decision — we'll present an apples-to-apples comparison during the workshop.
3) I attached a short Dedicated primer and a proposed deployment map to help your infra team review quickly.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Can we schedule the architecture workshop the week of June 8? Please suggest 2 slots that work for you.
- Can you confirm which decision-makers should attend (security, infra, procurement)?

Ballpark pricing & timeline: I'll share a two-option ballpark (pilot vs reserved) in a follow-up email after the workshop. If timing is tight, we can discuss a short paid pilot to validate latency/cost before committing to a reserved plan.

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Primer.pdf, proposed-deployment-map.xlsx

Thanks — happy to adjust based on who needs to be involved.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com
(415) 555-0162
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-06-06T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Checking in — private deployment timing

Hi Tom / Ava — just bumping this thread in case the workshop scheduling got buried. We want to make sure we align on the right deployment path (Redwood Dedicated vs Private VPC/on‑prem) so the SRE/security folks have the right artifacts.

Quick options to move forward:
- Option A: 30–45m architecture workshop to confirm network/KMS/identity.
- Option B: If procurement is the gating issue, we can send a short procurement checklist and an outline of SOC2/HSM attestations so your security team can triage asynchronously.

Would either of these be helpful this week or next? If timelines shifted (e.g., Q3 procurement), tell me and I’ll adjust follow-ups accordingly — no pressure.

If I don’t hear back, I’ll follow up once more with a concise checklist and a tentative architect slot to save your team time.

Thanks — Stephanie
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-06-09T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Checking in — procurement & pilot options

Hi Tom / Ava — quick note from our side to make this easier for procurement/security: I attached a procurement checklist that lists the typical artifacts customers request (SOC reports, encryption details, IP & network diagrams, SLAs). For customers with PHI we often recommend a 4–6 week pilot on Dedicated to validate latency and controls before moving to a longer-term Private/VPC engagement.

If it helps, we can also: 
- Lock a 2-week architect availability window (no obligation) for your infra team.
- Put a provisional pilot pricing estimate on paper to speed internal approvals.

Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf

Let me know who on your side owns procurement/security and I’ll route the checklist and a short slide that maps controls to our Private offering.

— Neha Kapoor

Thanks for the follow-ups — the recap and attachments are helpful. Quick update from our side: 
- We are still evaluating internal priorities; procurement is likely to be Q3 rather than June.
- Security wants to review SOC2/HSM/Audit log artifacts first; please send any concise one‑pagers that make that review quick.
- We are inclined toward a Private/VPC model but need the architecture workshop to validate integration points.

Ava and I can tentatively hold June 22 at 10:00am PT for the architecture workshop — can you confirm? If that slot works, please send a calendar invite and a 20–30m agenda geared to PHI/compliance and network items.
